design: Same H692 architecture, initialization seeds and batch streams. Train binary cross entropy on training-only H693 exact-search decisions at original0.01cost; no teacher gate labels. Select checkpoint every100steps by validation reconstruction-plus-count objective, as H692. Evaluate held combinations only after selection.
limitations: Frozen representation originally learned with supplied gates. Search-derived supervision, not joint unsupervised learning. BCE surrogate differs from reconstruction objective. Extra exact-search compute. Only three seeds and one teacher.
